fields.label: Title
fields.description: A name for this scheduled report.

fields.label: Report
fields.description: The ERPNext report to render and send.

fields.label: Format
fields.description: Output format of the report file that is sent.

fields.label: Report Filters (JSON)
fields.description: Optional filters passed to the report, as a JSON object. Example: {"company": "My Co", "from_date": "2026-01-01"}.

fields.label: Message Caption
fields.description: Optional text sent with the report file.

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Type of the recipient party (e.g. Customer, Supplier, User, Contact).

fields.label: Party
fields.description: The specific recipient. Their mobile number is resolved from the linked primary contact.

fields.label: Recipient Mobile (override)
fields.description: Optional. If set, the report is sent to this number and the party lookup is skipped.

fields.label: Send From Instance
fields.description: The connected WhatsApp instance used to send. Leave empty to use the current user's instance.

fields.label: Send Time
fields.description: Hour of day to send (the report is sent within the matching hour).

fields.label: Repeat Every
fields.description: Repeat interval (every N days/weeks/months depending on Frequency).

fields.label: Day of Month
fields.description: Day of the month (1-31) to send on, for Monthly frequency.

fields.label: Day of Week
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
